name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Estonia blames Russia's GRU for a 14 Nov arson plot on a drone maker; drones briefly shut Sigonella airfield on 20 Nov
state: Estonia's prime minister said Russia's GRU ordered the attempted explosion and fire at drone maker Threod Systems in Tallinn on 14 Nov; eight suspects were detained and significant damage was prevented (The Defense Post, 18 Nov). Drone sightings closed the Sigonella air base in Sicily for some hours on 20 Nov and Genoa airport for about two hours on 19 Nov; Italian sources suggested a likely civilian drone at Sigonella and no state has been blamed (DroneXL). No sabotage causing casualties or a major outage was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Short airport closures from drone sightings can delay or divert flights; check with your airline. Police and security services across Europe, including MI5 and UK counter-terrorism policing, ask the public to report suspicious approaches or offers of paid tasks.
rubric_hit: Watch: sabotage attempt attributed to Russia's GRU by Estonia (14 Nov); drone sightings closed Sigonella base (20 Nov)

sources.title: The Defense Post — Estonia accuses Russia of plot against drone maker
DroneXL — US Navy counts 3 drones at Sigonella; Italian sources describe one

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
